dataset_screening.reason: Longitudinal 64-channel continuous eyes-open and eyes-closed resting-state EEG at baseline and approximately five-year follow-up; CC0; versioned DOI.
Longitudinal randomized controlled trial, but the EEG recordings are task ERP rather than continuous resting state.
Continuous rest and a DOI are available, but recordings are repeated on one day rather than longitudinal and contain only four EEG channels.

selected_dataset.title: Resting-state EEG data before and after cognitive activity across the adult lifespan and a 5-year follow-up

pilot_sample.selection_rule: Among participants with session2=yes and late_ses1=late_ses2=0, sort by participant_id and take the first two women and first two men in each baseline age band 20-39, 40-54, and 55-70 years.
pilot_sample.recordings: acq-pre eyes-open and eyes-closed continuous EEG from sessions 1 and 2

primary_endpoint.metric: Mean upper-triangle posterior-region alpha-band (8-13 Hz) Phase Lag Index after NeuroStat Traditional preprocessing
primary_endpoint.contrast: Eyes closed minus eyes open, averaged within subject across sessions before inferential testing

pre_registered_gate.integrity: All 48 planned EDF recordings must be present, SHA-256 hashed, and processed successfully; at least 12 subjects must have all four recordings.
pre_registered_gate.primary_effect: Across-session subject-average EC minus EO must be positive with a paired two-sided t-test p < 0.05 and paired Cohen's d >= 0.50.
pre_registered_gate.session_consistency: The mean EC minus EO contrast must be positive in both sessions, with at least 8 of 12 subjects positive in each session.
pre_registered_gate.decision: PASS only if integrity, primary_effect, and session_consistency all pass. Otherwise report FAIL without changing preprocessing or endpoints.

exploratory_endpoints: Five-year Pearson and Spearman correlations for eyes-open, eyes-closed, and EC-minus-EO posterior alpha PLI.
Two-way absolute-agreement single-measure ICC(A,1) with deterministic bootstrap confidence intervals.
Session-specific paired state effects and subject-level processing QC.

analysis_parameters.preprocessing: Traditional: bad-channel interpolation plus 15-component FastICA/ICLabel; ASR disabled

interpretation_limits: This is a representative pipeline-validation subset, not the publication-powered analysis of all 208 follow-up participants.
The primary endpoint is sensor-space PLI and does not independently validate source localization.
Longitudinal reliability estimates from 12 subjects are exploratory and expected to have wide confidence intervals.
